scope: First working system suspend (s2idle) on the Fx0: in-cell touchscreen and MDP5 fixes
kernel_support: s2idle only (/sys/power/mem_sleep [s2idle]); no cpuidle states; wake sources include the PM8226 RTC and power key

touch_blocks_suspend.symptom: rmi_i2c suspend fails with -110 and aborts s2idle
touch_blocks_suspend.trace: msm's PM prepare switches the display off (68.105-68.320 s); at 68.293 s the PLG430 raises an interrupt and every I2C transfer to it stalls 15.4 s and times out (IRQ-thread read, then the F01 sleep-mode write [0e 81]); the stock LG driver sent panel TP-disable commands around touch power changes - the controller is part of the in-cell panel
touch_blocks_suspend.aftermath: rmi_i2c_suspend() asserts reset and disables the supplies, then returns the error; the PM core never resumes that device, so touch stays dead (GPIO16 driven low) until the driver is rebound

mdp5_stale_hwpipe.symptom: after one successful suspend/resume (or a failed suspend's prepare/complete), the next DPMS off or suspend prepare warns at mdp5_pipe.c:138 and msm_kms_pm_prepare returns -22
mdp5_stale_hwpipe.cause: drm_atomic_helper_suspend() saves plane states but not the mdp5 global (private object) state; the suspend commit releases every hwpipe in the global state; the resume commit restores plane states that still name their old hwpipes, which the atomic check keeps without re-recording them
